name: Haumea
tagline: The spinning cigar — a dwarf planet stretched by the fastest rotation in the Kuiper belt.

facts.label: Surface
facts.value: Crystalline water ice, bright and young

history: Haumea spins so fast — once every 3.9 hours — that centrifugal force has stretched it into a cigar three times longer than it is wide, one of the most extreme figures in the Solar System. Its surface is almost pure crystalline water ice, a crust that should have darkened long ago unless a giant impact re-formed it. Haumea anchors its own collisional family of icy fragments and carries two moons plus a narrow ring discovered by stellar occultation in 2017.
